2. Меңгеру (government/rection) – the head word governs the dependent word, requiring it to take a specific case ending.
3. Матасу (coordination/concord) – the dependent word agrees with the head word in person and number (typically possessive constructions).

A) «Кешегі жаңбыр» – 'кешегі' is a derived adjective (from 'кеше' + -гі) modifying 'жаңбыр'. The dependent word 'кешегі' has no case ending and simply precedes the noun. However, in the strict three-way classification, adjective+noun is қабысу, not жанасу. Жанасу typically refers to adverb+verb connections. So this may be incorrect.
